WITH per_telescope AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) as avg_mod
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_mod) as overall_avg
  FROM per_telescope
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT pt.telescref, pt.avg_mod
  FROM per_telescope pt, overall_avg oa
  WHERE pt.avg_mod > oa.overall_avg
),
mean_above_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_mod) as mean_of_above
  FROM above_avg
)
SELECT 
  aa.telescref,
  aa.avg_mod,
  aa.avg_mod - oa.overall_avg as above_overall,
  aa.avg_mod / maa.mean_of_above as ratio
FROM above_avg aa, overall_avg oa, mean_above_avg maa
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
